Fuel options available in the Marine_Fuel tab (R&D GREET 2025). 2.1.3 Input Parameters 2.1.3.1 Fuel Properties This subsection compiles information on the fuel properties of the 39 available fuels in the Marine_Fuel tab (R&D GREET 2025). The listed properties include lower heating value (LHV, in MJ/kg), higher heating value (HHV, in MJ/kg), density (kg/L), carbon ratio (% by weight), sulfur ratio (% by weight), and the carbon credit (% by weight) a particular fuel can credit in combustion stage depending on the feedstock used. 2.1.3.2 Engine Type and Energy Consumption This subsection presents the energy consumption (Btu/kWh of operation) of the main engine and auxiliary engine, based on the LHV and the fuel consumption for each engine converter and fuel group type. Figure 7 shows the assumed fuel consumption for each engine type and fuel. These values were updated using data from the Fourth IMO GHG Study report and are further described in section Fuel Consumption within the Marine_Trip tab, also displayed in Table B7 in Appendix B.
